title: Don't trust it blindly
goal: Catch AI's mistakes — facts, level, bias, and local fit.

blocks.title: Your superpower
blocks.body:
Here's what your students won't teach you: AI can be confidently wrong.

Catching it is your superpower. Check four things: the facts, the level, any bias, and whether it actually fits what you're teaching.

blocks.question: An AI answer says: "Photosynthesis happens in the mitochondria." What do you do?

options.text: Catch it — that's wrong (it's the chloroplast) and fix it

blocks.explanation: Caught it. 👏 The AI said it with total confidence — and it was wrong. That instinct is the skill no tool replaces.

blocks.question: An AI worksheet uses dollars ($) and Fahrenheit for your Indian classroom. That's a problem of…
blocks.explanation: Right — it's not wrong, it just doesn't fit your class. Ask for local context (₹, Celsius, familiar examples).

blocks.question: How ready do you feel to spot AI's mistakes?
